stories.title: Senedd manifestos lack fiscal credibility on tax and spending, says IFS
stories.summary: Every major Welsh party’s Senedd manifesto would add to financial pressure on the next Welsh Government, the Institute for Fiscal Studies has said three days before polling. stories.title: Welsh Labour manifesto: What it says and what it means for Wales
stories.summary: Having been in power since devolution began in 1999, Welsh Labour has become synonymous with Welsh politics. stories.title: Most drivers do not trust ‘road ahead closed’ signs, RAC research finds
stories.summary: More than half of drivers find the red “road ahead closed” signs they see on Britain’s roads uninformative, new research from the RAC has found. stories.title: BT digital hub on Queensferry’s Station Road gets council approval
stories.summary: BT has been given the go-ahead to install a digital advertising hub on Queensferry’s Station Road, weeks after a similar plan was refused in Shotton.
